        return
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    if n > m:
        n, m = m, n
    if n > 2:
        print((n * m) // 2 * 2)
    elif n == 1:
        print((m // 6) * 6 + 2 * max((m % 6 - 3), 0))
    elif n == 2:
        if m == 2:
            print(0)
        elif m == 3:
            print(4)
        elif m == 7:
            print(12)
        else:
            print(2 * m)

    main()
